zh-CN.title: 多人投稿协作
items: 投稿与审批现在都支持多人协作，列表会清晰展示参与者和协作人数
审批者可以邀请投稿者或其他审批者，受邀者同意后即可查看完整历史消息
投稿详情页现在按投稿者与审批者分别展示成员

en.title: Collaborative submissions
items: Submissions and reviews now support multiple collaborators with clearer participant details
Reviewers can invite authors or other reviewers, who gain full history access after accepting
Submission details now separate authors and reviewers into clear member lists
